title: Kwacoco (Steamed Grated Cocoyam)
author: Imma Adamu (Immaculate Bites)
desc: Peeled cocoyam pulsed with a little water, wrapped in foil-lined plastic wrap or banana leaves and steamed about an hour — served with mbanga or palm-nut soup.
longDesc: The plain kwacoco: three pounds of cocoyam are peeled, bruised spots cut out, cut into large chunks and rinsed immediately to prevent discolouration. They are pulsed in a food processor until pureed with just enough water, about a cup per package is wrapped in heat-resistant plastic wrap inside foil (or banana leaves), the sides folded in twice to seal, and the packages are steamed about an hour. The page serves it with mbanga or palm-nut soup.
ingredients: 1–2 teaspoons (5–10 g) salt (author used garlic salt)
Banana leaves, or foil lined with heat-resistant plastic wrap
steps: Peel the cocoyam and remove any bruising and discolouration.
Cut into large chunks and rinse immediately to prevent discolouration.
Pulse in a food processor until pureed, adding just enough water.
Wrap about a cup of the puree per package. Fold the sides in twice to seal.
Steam for about an hour. Serve with mbanga or palm-nut soup.
chefTips: No doneness cue is printed beyond ‘about an hour’.
Use heat-resistant wrap that will not melt (page advice).
Rinse the cut chunks right away.
commonMistakes: Leaving the peeled cocoyam to discolour.
Using ordinary plastic wrap that can melt.
healthBenefits: Cocoyam is a starchy staple; this version adds almost no fat.
culturalNote: The page describes kwacoco as a traditional Cameroonian dish and does not name a community. The ‘kwacoco bible’ (CMR019) is described by the same author as a Bakweri staple.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Kwacoco’ (print view). Byline as printed: ‘Imma Adamu’ (‘Imma’ on the card). Published 13 Feb 2013, last update 11 Feb 2025. Yield 4. Prep 15 min, cook 1 h, total 1 h 15 min. Ingredients TWO-PASS; method SINGLE-PASS.
As printed: ‘3 pounds (1.5k)’ — the metric unit is incomplete. ABSENT: a doneness cue; the mbanga soup recipe itself (no usable mbanga printing was found).
